note: Shot list. Each shot starts on a spoken word of the measured take (anchor: segment, word, n-th match, offset in seconds) and ends where the next one starts; src/video/shots.ts resolves the anchors to frames, tools/storyboard.mjs writes output/storyboard.md with the measured times.

shots.scene_goal: Hook: a picture in motion from frame 0, no title card
shots.action: A banana peel is already flying at the lens, spins and slaps down; the monkey is finishing the throw and grins
shots.camera: Starts tight on the landing spot (×1.7), pulls back to the zoo and its sign (×0.9); 6 px shake on the landing
shots.visual_punchline: We meet the culprit before the sentence ends

shots.scene_goal: Establish the monkey's innocence: it just eats
shots.action: Peels the banana, bites on «موزته», chews with happy closed eyes

shots.scene_goal: The act we will compare against
shots.action: Tosses the peel over its shoulder without looking; it arcs onto a pile of old peels; pats its belly on «ظهره»
shots.camera: Medium (×1.3), small punch-in on the throw
shots.visual_punchline: The pile shows it's a habit

shots.action: Laughs, slaps the desk on the word, shoulders bounce; mouth follows the voice

shots.scene_goal: Why the monkey is excused: it doesn't know what a bin is
shots.action: Scratches its head on «قرد», then lifts the bin and wears it as a hat on «السلة», proud
Holds a pictogram sign upside down and tilts its head further and further to read it
shots.visual_punchline: Head tilted 46° to match the upside-down sign

shots.scene_goal: The turn: from the monkey to the viewer
shots.action: Looks aside (toward the monkey), squints on «طيب», turns and points at the viewer on «وأنت؟»

shots.scene_goal: The human: a brain, and he can read
shots.action: Walks in munching from his red snack bag; a bulb lights above his head on «عقل»; stops at the sign on «وتقرأ»

shots.scene_goal: He reads the rule — and agrees with it
shots.action: His eyes travel right to left along the sign; a red marker underlines each line exactly while it is spoken; nods approvingly on «المكان»
shots.camera: Close (×1.7→1.78) on the sign and his face
shots.visual_punchline: He agrees with the sign he is about to ignore

shots.action: Raises the empty bag high, eyes closed tenderly, opens his fingers on «يدك»
shots.visual_punchline: A ceremony for a piece of litter

shots.narration: فيطير الكيس… كأنك تطلق حمامة سلام.
shots.scene_goal: The central joke, seen as well as heard
shots.action: The bag grows white wings and flutters up into a glow, feathers drifting, while he waves; on «سلام» sparkles — then the wings vanish and it drops like a stone
shots.sound: flutter, soft chime on «سلام», pop, falling whistle

shots.action: The bag slaps down by the sign; sunglasses drop onto his face on «وتمشي»; he swaggers off left
shots.visual_punchline: Cool exit over his own litter

shots.action: Arms folded, deadpan eye-roll

shots.scene_goal: Comic pause: the bag alone under the sign
shots.action: A breeze nudges the bag; a leaf blows past
shots.visual_punchline: «حافظ على نظافة المكان» above the litter

shots.action: Walks in with broom and dustpan, sees the bag, his face tires
Bends on «ينحني», picks the bag; his back creaks; a counter pops: 1
Another bag drops in from above; he bends again on «قبلك»: 2
A third bag and a peel drop; third bend on «بعدك»: 3; he straightens holding his back, sweating
shots.camera: Push-in ×1.3→1.5, small shake on the pick

shots.action: Shows empty palms on «يرمي», innocent smile, a little halo of sparkles

shots.scene_goal: The habit, shown without disgusting detail
shots.action: Turns and spits once (one small drop); a passer-by has to hop over the spot on «الرصيف»
shots.sound: soft spit, boing on the hop

shots.action: Plants a red flag on the spot on «كأنه», hands on hips, chin up

shots.scene_goal: Reversal: the excused animal does better
shots.action: Drops a stray bag into the bin (lid flips), dusts its hands on «له», gives the camera a judging look on «عذر»
Open hands on «أما»; hand on his chest on «كرّمك»; a warm glow fills the backdrop
Folds the empty bag small on «احتفظ» and tucks it into his shirt pocket on «جيبك»
Walks to the bin; on «سلة» the folded bag goes in, the lid flips, the bin smiles; thumbs-up

shots.scene_goal: From not harming to removing harm
shots.action: He bends and clears a peel from the path into the bin; on «صدقة» the cleaner straightens his back with relief; the light warms
shots.visual_punchline: The cleaner gets his back back

shots.narration: فعلى الأقل، لا تكن أنت الأذى.
shots.scene_goal: The line to remember, then out fast
shots.action: Points on «لا تكن»; the card «لا تكن أنت الأذى» lands (الأذى in red); he nods; the monkey pops up with a thumbs-up; ends 1.3 s after the last word
